title: Riglane Hook — Claude Code SubagentStop Input
description: Schema for the JSON payload Claude Code sends to gate-check via stdin on the SubagentStop event. Note: CC's payload shape is owned by Claude Code itself; this schema documents the subset the engine consumes. Unknown fields MUST be tolerated.
description-discriminators: Presence of any of agent_id, agent_transcript_path, or agent_type identifies the input as Claude Code (per the riglane gate-check host detection).

agent_id.description: Claude Code subagent identifier. Presence of this field implies CC host.

agent_transcript_path.description: Path to the subagent's full transcript file. Presence implies CC host.

agent_type.description: Agent type identifier. Presence implies CC host.

hook_event_name.description: Event name. CC may send 'SubagentStop'. Cursor 2.6.19+ also sends this field, so it is NOT a reliable host discriminator.

task.description: Task prompt sent to the subagent. May be null in CC (transcript-based; not always populated).

model.description: Model identifier. CC may include this; otherwise extractable from transcript.

status.description: Subagent termination status. CC subagent stop fires once on completion; status field MAY be omitted.
